description: Scope mirrors the Dependabot config this replaces: Maven (root pom drives every module) and GitHub Actions.
dependencyDashboard is explicit here (the extended preset already sets it) so issue #9 stays enabled even if the shared preset changes.

agon-core and agon-server are this reactor's own modules, declared in the parent dependencyManagement for cross-module version pinning, not published to any registry; ignoreDeps stops Renovate from trying to look them up on every run (issue #9).
